results.claim: The overall U.S. market projection for legal adult-use and medical cannabis sales is expected to reach $22.8 billion by 2029, with a CAGR of 28%.
results.explanation: Multiple authoritative industry sources materially contradict both the $22.8 billion endpoint and the 28% CAGR. Grand View Research (grandviewresearch.com/industry-analysis/us-cannabis-market) estimates the U.S. cannabis market was already $38.50 billion in 2024 — meaning a 2029 projection of $22.8 billion would actually imply severe market contraction, not growth. BDSA data cited by Cannabis Science and Technology (cannabissciencetech.com) projects U.S. regulated adult-use and medical combined sales to reach $39.1 billion by 2029, with 2025 adult-use alone at $23.9 billion. MJ Biz Daily (mjbizdaily.com) reported combined U.S. medical and recreational sales could reach $33.6 billion as far back as end-of-2023. On the CAGR, no U.S.-specific forecast aligns with 28%: Grand View Research puts it at 11.51% (2025–2030), Statista (statista.com) at 3.36% (2025–2030), and Technavio (technavio.com) at 37.1% (2024–2029). The $22.8 billion figure is closest to Statista's global medical-cannabis-only projection of $22.46 billion by 2029 — a much narrower scope than total U.S. adult-use plus medical — suggesting possible scope or geographic confusion in the original claim.

results.claim: Recreational cannabis sales will account for more than 53% of the overall U.S. cannabis market by 2029.
results.explanation: Multiple authoritative industry sources confirm that recreational (adult-use) cannabis already exceeds 53% of the U.S. cannabis market today — making the 2029 threshold claim conservative rather than aggressive. Grand View Research (grandviewresearch.com/industry-analysis/us-cannabis-market) reported recreational use held a 66.9% revenue share as of 2024, well above the claimed 53% floor. Market.us (market.us/report/us-cannabis-market/) similarly placed the recreational segment at 55.7% market share in 2024, already surpassing the claim's threshold. Furthermore, cannabusinessplans.com projects adult-use sales to represent more than 80% of the North American cannabis market by 2027–2030. The claim's directional logic — that recreational will exceed 53% by 2029 — is strongly supported, though the actual share will likely be materially higher than 53% by that date. The only notable dissent comes from Nova One Advisor (novaoneadvisor.com), which placed the medical segment at 77% in 2025, though this likely reflects a different market scope or segment definition. On balance, the claim is consistent with the preponderance of credible sources.
